rationale: The assistant handled the hose step well, but then asked the customer to remove the filter after she had said she wouldn't, ignoring her stated refusal. It never offered the controlled drain via the small tube (with towels and tray), which was the expected safe alternative. It then re-asked about the hum already reported and said 'Not really' and 'needs an engineer', although her husband could clean the filter at the weekend. The final advice to stop spin cycles and leave the machine unplugged is safe but thin, with no help getting the water out of the drum.
